programme.title: Arborek Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: Arborek is a tiny island in Raja Ampat archipelago, on west Papua. It is easily walkable on foot, taking roughly thirty minutes to walk the entire coastline. The island is known for its very hospitable tourism village and exceptional handicrafts with a thriving souvenir community. Be ready to be greeted with open arms by everyone, with many children who are eager to be photographed. This authentic island welcomes guests with pride, the islanders are happy to introduce all to the Papuan culture and unique traditional foods. It is a perfect paradise to learn a bit of the Asai culture, which is still kept alive in this isolated place. Arborek island, traditionally a mooring spot for boatmen, is surrounded by splendid sago palms, nourished by fish and it is sparsely populated by a tiny population of around 200 residents, spread in around 40 families. The water is crystal clear, with white fine sand and many coconut trees and bushes, providing a quite comforting and refreshing atmosphere. At the wooden pier you will find some gazebos, ideal for relaxing.

programme.title: Dive Site Paso Del Cedral, Cozumel, Mexico
programme.desc: Paso Del Cedral dive site is located in front of El Cedral in the south west of Cozumel. Also called Cedral Wall it is one of the most beautiful dive sites in Cozumel. It can be done as a wall dive or closer to shore over the reef. The part of the reef that is not a wall, consists of a mile of sloping hills covered in sponges and coral. The reef bottoms out at about 18 meters (60 feet). As for the current, it's generally moderate to strong. As you drift you'll get to see eagle rays, lobsters, hawksbill turtles, green morays, big pufferfish, toadfish, and even sharks.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Zapote, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. Cenote Zapote is named after the Sapote trees growing nearby. It is located on the “Ruta de los Cenotes” the old road from Puerto Morelos to Valladolid. Zapote has quite a deep drop from the land surface to the water surface of 6m/20ft but its access is easy via stairs. The walls will rise above you like a fortress and once you start your descent they become narrower until a depth of 20m/66ft before starting to open back up again. Once you reach a depth of 30m/100ft you will be above the talus cone in a bell shaped chamber with a narrow skylight in the top through which you just descended. Halocline and a thin misty layer of Hydrogen Sulfide floating on top of it, as well as some of the most amazing and incredible formations commonly described as bells, elephant feet, shower heads or trumpets will truly take your breath away with their strange beauty and impressive size.

programme.title: Dive Site Saporkren at Night, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai. This site is typically dived at night, however day diving is good too. Saporkren is your typical sandy bottom muck dive site, which is a little grubby since its just off of the village jetty. Making your way down a gentle slope (with little or no current) past a few coral bommies, the best bit of Saporkren is generally around 12-20 metres. We found full-size seahorses, cute bobtail squid, flying flatworms, clownfish anemones, colemani shrimp plus many unusual crabs species such as the boxer, xeno and porcelain.

programme.title: Padar island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island. Padar is the third largest island in the Komodo National Park. It is located in the south central of the park, between Komodo and Rinca Island. In the past, Padar was one of the island in Komodo where there were dragons live. Along with the illegal hunting activities by human being, they are slowly disappeared and almost unable to see them anymore. The cause is simply because of the lack of foods, like deer and wild boar. Their extinction can be because they just died alone without any food to eat or prolonged hunger or they can be migrated to nearest island, Rinca. The island now remains empty with no dragons. However, other wild animals such as wild boars are still around daily. Today, Padar has become one of the most popular place to visit in Indonesia. It offers super magnificent view from the top of the island with pink sandy beach on the west side and white sandy beach on the east side. Formation of towering hill, just like Jurassic park. Although the island has no dragons existed, the island is one of the best charming spot of trekking. Those who love photographic, this is perhaps the best place for spectacular photos.

programme.title: Dive Site C56 Shipwreck, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos. The C-56 shipwreck served in World War II and it was sold to the Mexican Marine in 1966. The time pass by and later on 28th Oct 2000 was purposefully sunk, as a new attraction for divers coming to the Riviera Maya. Laying perfectly upright, with the keel on the sand at 90ft, the 184ft long Mexican Gun Boat was quickly inhabited by various marine life. The deck, at 64ft, is teeming with life and it's common to see a large shoal of Big Eye Travellies hunting there. As we travel around the wreck we commonly see large Wrasse, Groupers, Morays and, looking up, flights of Eagle Rays. Soft corals have colonized the wreck and now offer a home to many Arrow crabs and Fire worms amongst other small crustaceans and invertebrates.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.title: Johanna Dohnal - Visionary of Feminism
programme.desc: Dohnal worked in the SPÖ from 1956 and was a minister from 1979 to 1995. Women's shelters, gender quotas, and equal treatment laws were established for the first time.

programme.title: Papa Gold
programme.desc: Denny has a mother. This mother has a new husband, Frank. Together they have a new baby. Denny has not spoken to his mother for 10 years. Frank wants to change that now. He travels to Berlin. Who will be the first to grow up? A sensitively portrayed tragicomedy by upcoming star director Tom Lass and outstanding acting by the charismatic Peter Trabner. Winner of the German Film Critics Prize.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Tiempo Para Nuestro Cuerpo y Mente

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Ártico canadiense
programme.desc: El reinado del hombre blanco. Los miembros de la expedición The Explorers parten al descubrimiento del Ártico canadiense, una región emblemática de los trastornos climáticos que afectan a nuestro planeta. Para acercarse lo más posible a una civilización y una naturaleza en plena mutación, y ser testigos de la evolución de la vida en estas tierras heladas, la expedición recorre el Extremo Norte canadiense, desde la primavera hasta principios del invierno.

programme.title: Eglise Sainte Anne et les Piscines de Bethesda, Israel

Nichee au cœur des rues animees et des ruelles du quartier musulman, l’eglise Sainte-Anne, la mieux conservee des eglises croisees de Jerusalem, se distingue par sa tranquillite. programme.title: Forhold på 4 hjul - Opp til fjelltoppen i bakkeløp.
programme.desc: Her møter vi mennesker og deres kjærlighet for ikke typiske motorsporter. I hver episode vil vi treffe to personer som driver med samme motorsport. Vi følger dem hjemme før vi blir med dem på et arrangement der de konkurrerer mot hverandre.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Steffen - "dagen derpå"
programme.desc: Etter uhellet på ACR i forrige episode er Steffen tilbake på plass i garasjen sin. Sykkelen hans er totalvrak og må rettes opp, i tillegg må nye deler på plass før det aller siste løpet i Superbike.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Et Roadracing løp kommer sjeldent uten problemer
programme.desc: I dagens episode blir vi bedre kjent med Alf og Jan som er klare for løp på Rudskogen. De konkurrerer i samme klasse, og mens de gjør seg klar til kamp sliter dessverre Steffen med sykkelen sin.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Årets første "wet-race" på ACR står for tur.
programme.desc: Lokasjonen for Roadrace-konkurransen er Arctic Circle Raceway! Det er første gangen Alf skal kjøre på vått føre, og Steffen har endelig fått orden på sykkelen sin. Men hos Team Kaos kan alt skje, og løpet tar en rask og uforventet vending.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Siste løp i Superbike 2017!
programme.desc: Om serien: I denne serien følger vi forskjellige motorsportutøvere gjennom deres racingsesong. Sporten, målene og forutsetningene er forskjellige, men felles for dem alle er lidenskapen for sporten sin og miljøet de er i.

programme.title: Min Motorsport - Roadracing med Steffen og Team Kaos
programme.desc: Steffen er en del av vennegjengen Team Kaos, og de har virkelig fortjent navnet sitt. De kjører alle roadracing,og medlemmene har forskjellig erfaring og konkurrerer i ulike klasser. Vi møter dem på Vålerbanen for sesongens første testkjøring.

programme.title: Garasjen - Testkjøring av Volvo 142, Formula Offroad bygging og motivlakkering av Audi.
programme.desc: Ivar og Asgeir skal teste Volvoen de har mekket på, og får noen tips på kjøreteknikk av en som virkelig kan det. Norges beste varebilsjåfør skal kåres. Vi møter også Sigurjon som skal bygge seg en Formula offroad bil helt fra scratch.

programme.title: Garasjen - Drifting på Rudskogen, Lille Bjørn og Rally Monte Carlo Historiqe start!
programme.desc: Vi treffer Tor Anders Ringnes, som lenge har jobbet med å gjøre bilen klar for driftssesongen. Bilen skal være klar til Rudskogen motorfestival. Videre går turen til Jarle i Risør, som åpner dørene til garasjen sin.

programme.title: Garasjen - Rally Monte Carlo Historiqe, Garasjebesøk i Kristiansand og ferdigstilling av Audien!
programme.desc: Ivar og Asgeir deltar i Rallye Monte Carlo Historique. Vi besøker garasjen til Melvin i Kristiansand. Asgeir har jobbet hardt for å få ferdig Audien sin. Nå er det klart for siste finish, før bilen skal EU-godkjennes.

programme.title: Garasjen - Pål Anders Ullevålseter, NTCC i Århus og en ødelagt kluch.
programme.desc: Vi blir med Asgeir Borgemoen inn i garasjene til en rekke motorentusiaster rundt om i Norge. Kjøretøyene og prosjektene varierer, men lidenskapen for prosjektene sine er like stor hos dem alle. Det er utrolig hva som skjuler seg bak en garasjeport!

programme.title: Garasjen - Kim Jannike sin BMW, Grensetreffet i Halden og nytt eksosanlegg!
programme.desc: Kim Jannike har bygget seg en BMW, og denne skal brukes i drifting, men når hun skal prøvekjøre bilen med Asgeir går ikke alt som planlagt. Det er også tid for Grensetreffet i Halden, hvor det er mange flotte biler å se på.

programme.title: Garasjen - Spesiell drømmebil, Finnskogfestivalen og en låve full av amcar
programme.desc: I denne episoden av Garasjen er det klart for Finnskogfestivalen. Der møter vi Line Myrvold og Leif André Ødegaard som skal konkurrere i bilcross og rallycross. Torbjørn viser oss også hans noe spesielle drømmebil.

programme.title: Garasjen - Nyinnkjøpt Ferrari, Volvo 142 og finale på Finnskogfestivalen
programme.desc: Vi møter vi Ivar og Asgeir. De har kjøpt en Volvo 142, som de skal bygge om til en rask rallybil for å delta i Rallye Monte-Carlo Historique. I Drammen treffer vi Arild Olsen som har kjøpt en Ferrari han ikke har sett på nett.

programme.title: Garasjen - Mekking av både Ferrari og Volvo 142, og et lite lakk kurs
programme.desc: Halvor Sunde fra Risør åpner dørene til sin egen garasje, som blant annet huser en strøken Hotrod. Asgeir besøker Arild og hans Ferrari, og gir ham en hjelpende hånd når motoren skal settes inn. Videre går turen til Gatebil on ice i Sigdal.

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Kia e-Soul
programme.desc: Ståle tester Kie e-Soul, som er proppfull av teknologi. Men kan det bli for mye av det gode?

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Audi e-tron GT
programme.desc: Audi eTron har vært en stor salgsuksess i Norge, og nå har de kommet med en mer sportslig utgave: Audi eTron GT. Vil Ståle sette like stor pris på denne sportslige utgaven, som han satte på Porsche Taycans sportlige utgave?

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Skoda Enyaq iV
programme.desc: Bilverden utvikler seg, og elbiler blir mer og mer vanlig. Med den skeptiske motorentusiasten Ståle Eskeland i spissen får vi et innblikk i hvordan bilene faktisk er å kjøre. Et biltest-program av elbiler, fra en motorelskers perspektiv.

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med BMW i3
programme.desc: Denne gangen tester Ståle BMW i3. Men kan den egentlig kalles for en sporty bil?

programme.title: Jeg går elektrisk - Jeg går elektrisk...med Nissan Leaf
programme.desc: Denne gangen tester Ståle hvordan Nissan Leaf er å kjøre. Fortjener virkelig Nissan Leaf "bestselger" tittelen sin? Vi får høre hva Ståle har å si.

programme.desc: Mellom 1990 og 2007 utvides bilindustrien. Toyota blir verdensomspennende, og sportsbilene blir mer og mer modne. Bruktbilmarkedet blomstrer og det nye årtusenet bringer mange nyvinninger.

programme.desc: Bilen har eksistert i over 100 år, og det har vært en lang vei å gå fra første testkjøring til ABS, Air condition og automatgir. Mer enn et århundre med utvikling, og vogna med motor blir stadig oppgradert til mer sofistikerte biler.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1930-1940

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Nio Battery-Swap
programme.desc: Der chinesische Autohersteller Nio geht das Thema "E-Auto laden" anders an als die Konkurrenz. In sogenannten Battery-Swap-Stations soll der Akku innerhalb von nur fünf Minuten gewechselt werden. Ist das die Zukunft der Elektromobilität? Alexander Bloch testet die Anlage und klärt die 9 größten Irrtümer zum Akkuwechsel beim E-Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Golf 7
programme.desc: Der VW Golf 7 ist eines der meistverkauften und beliebtesten Modelle des Volkswagenkonzerns. Worauf man beim Kauf eines gebrauchten Golf 7 achten muss erklärt Alexander Bloch. Egal ob Probleme mit dem AGR-Ventil, dem DSG-Getriebe und Rost, die Schwachstellen und guten Seiten des Wolfsburger Dauerbrenners kommen hier zum Vorschein.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 1.000.000 Kilometer
programme.desc: In der 100. Folge von Bloch erklärt kümmert sich Alex um das Thema Dauerläufer: Wie hält dein Auto ewig? Im Mittelpunkt steht ein Lexus LS400 mit einer Million Kilometer auf der Uhr. Wie fährt sich so ein Kilometerfresser eigentlich? Und was muss man tun, damit das eigene Auto auch das Zeug zum Dauerläufer hat? Alex Bloch erklärt euch 10 wichtige Regeln - das wird gut!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Autos 2023
programme.desc: Die Lieferzeiten bei Elektroautos sind lang. Doch zumindest wird 2023 die Auswahl deutlich größer. Besonders die chinesischen Hersteller wollen angreifen und zeigen zahlreiche Neuheiten. Aber auch die deutschen Produzenten legen nach. Alexander Bloch zeigt seine 10 Highlights für das Jahr 2023. Hier seht ihr seine Favoriten.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Sicherheits-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Welche Autos sind am sichersten? Welche Aussagekraft haben Crashtests überhaupt? Warum spielt die Farbe eines Autos in der Unfallstatistik eine Rolle? Die Antwort auf diese Fragen und weitere spannende Informationen rund um das Thema Verkehrssicherheit gibt es in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt. Zudem findet Alexander Bloch unter den Testdummies einen neuen Freund: Thor!

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Renault Megane etech
programme.desc: Alex nimmt den Renault Megane E-Tech 220 im Supertest unter die Lupe: Während er bei der Innenraum-Qualität Pluspunkte sammeln kann, gibt es an anderer Stelle Verbesserungspotenzial.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - VW ID.Buzz
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch prüft den Volkswagen ID.Buzz auf Herz und Nieren. Was hat der Bus auf MEB-Basis zu bieten?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - VW ID.4 GTX
programme.desc: VW schickt den ID.4 zum renovierten und verschärften Elektro-Auto-Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Kann der Wolfsburger überzeugen? Er bringt einige große Stärken mit zum Test, offenbart aber auch ärgerliche Schwächen im Detail.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Absima Sherpa RC: Alex vs. Lance
programme.desc: Neuauflage des RC-Duells zwischen Alex Bloch und Lance David Arnold. Auf der Strecke des RCRT Duisburg geht es heute nicht um Schnelligkeit, sondern genaues fahren. Wer schafft den Trail-Parcous fehlerfrei mit seinem Absima Sherpa?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Fendt 1050 Vario-Teil 2
programme.desc: Unter der Motorhaube des größten Standard-Traktor der Welt brummt ein 12,4-Liter-Reihensechszylinder-Diesel. Alexander Bloch fährt den Fendt 1050 Vario auf der Teststrecke Probe. Außerdem wartet eine kleine Herausforderung auf Alex, die viel Fingerspitzengefühl erfordert.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Carrera Bahn
programme.desc: Sie ist einer der Spiele-Klassiker und darf in keinem Kinderzimmer eines echten Petrolheads fehlen: Die Carrera Bahn. Doch wie genau funktioniert die Bahn? Welche Technik wird eingesetzt? Und was kann man optimieren? Das alles und noch viel Mehr bei Bloch spielt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Fendt 1050 Vario-Teil 1
programme.desc: Fendt 1050 Vario: der stärkste Standard-Traktor der Welt! Er leistet beachtliche 517 PS und 2.420 Newtonmeter Drehmoment. Wie der Gigant produziert wird und welche technischen Raffinessen er zu bieten hat, schaut sich Alexander Bloch in den heiligen Hallen von Fendt an.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - VW ID.7 Effizienzcheck (Teil 1)
programme.desc: Alex Bloch checkt den neuen VW ID.7 und weiht Euch in die Geheimnisse seines Antriebs ein. Die große Frage: Wie effizient kann ein Elektromotor sein und was kann man machen um ihn effizienter zu bekommen?

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Doppelkupplungsgetriebe
programme.desc: Das Doppelkupplungsgetriebe hat in vielen Modellen die klassische Wandler-Automatik abgelöst. Größter Vorteil: nahezu keine Zugkraftunterbrechung. Doch die Technik ist nicht unumstritten - gerade in Bezug auf Komfort und Haltbarkeit. Alexander Bloch erklärt die 6 größten Irrtümer zum Doppelkupplungsgetriebe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Motor-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Egal ob Benziner, Diesel oder Elektro: Ohne Motor geht nichts. Dabei gibt es rund um die Motorentechnik viele Stammtischweisheiten: z.B. Hubraum ist durch nichts zu ersetzen. Aber ist das wirklich so? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 10 größten Irrtümer zu Downsizing, Turbo und Co.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Starter-Batterie
programme.desc: Es ist faszinierend: wir fahren mit modernsten Autos durch die Gegend, diskutieren über Lithium-Ionen-Akkus und trotzdem würde ohne eine jahrhundertealte Stromspeicher-Technologie quasi der komplette Autoverkehr stillstehen: Der Bleiakkumulator. Alt genug, damit sich eine Menge Irrtümer bilden konnten. Wir klären heute die 8 größten Irrtümer zur Starterbatterie und geben Tipps zum Tausch und zur Starthilfe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Energie-Verschwendung: So machst DU es richtig!
programme.desc: Während ganz Deutschland über Nachhaltigkeit, Energiewende und Effizienz von Autos diskutiert, drehen wir den Spieß um: Alexander Bloch hat die Gebote des Mehrverbrauchs. So verschwendest du am besten Energie!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Komatsu PC4000
programme.desc: Der Komatsu PC4000 bringt einige Superlative mit sich. Das Riesengerät wird nicht nur in Deutschland gebaut, sondern auch bewegt. In einem Steinbruch bei Düsseldorf verrichtet dieser Brecher sein Werk und Alexander Bloch darf ihn erklären.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Renault Scenic E-Tech: Überzeugend, aber da wäre noch mehr drin gewesen!
programme.desc: Der Renault Scenic hat sich vom Verbrenner-Van zum Elektro-SUV gewandelt. Pluspunkte gibt‘s für den modernen Innenraum, das großzügige Platzangebot und das auf Komfort ausgelegte Fahrwerk. Wie der Familien-Stromer auf ganzer Linie abschneidet, seht ihr jetzt im E-Auto-Supertest mit Alex Bloch.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Honda e:Ny1 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Nach hübsch und unpraktisch, jetzt normal und praktisch? Der Honda e war der erste Versuch der Japaner mit einem vollelektrischen Fahrzeug. Der Neue mit dem unaussprechlichen Namen e:Ny1 basiert auf der von Honda neu entwickelten Frontantriebsplattform e:N Architecture F, die weltweit in Elektrofahrzeugen im B-Segment zum Einsatz kommen wird. Wie schlägt sich das kompakte SUV im E-Auto Supertest?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Kia EV9 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Kia EV9 ist der „King Kong“ unter den SUVs – ein imposanter Koloss, den manche als überdimensioniert und unnötig empfinden. Alexander Bloch räumt mit diesen Vorurteilen auf und stellt den EV9 im direkten Vergleich zum beliebten VW ID.Buzz unter Beweis.

Un gruppo di eroi improbabili deve unire le forze per fermare la distruzione e salvare il mondo da una catastrofe imminente.

programme.title: 2012: Il Giorno Del Giudizio
programme.desc: 21 dicembre 2012. Quattro stranieri in viaggio si ritrovano ai piedi di un antico tempio inesplorato nel cuore del Messico. Per i Maya è l'ultimo giorno del calendario, per gli scienziati della Nasa è una catastrofica inversione dei poli magnetici della terra. Per l'umanità è il giorno del giudizio. L'apocalisse è vicina.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age - Una Nuova Era Glaciale
programme.desc: Un'eruzione vulcanica in Islanda provoca un progressivo congelamento di tutto il Nord America. Un padre di famiglia lotta per sfuggire all'assalto della glaciazione in arrivo che potrebbe estinguere l'intera umanità. I raggi solari non passano, la Terra sta entrando in una nuova Era Glaciale.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: La Terra è solo un puntino nell'universo, e se ne accorgeranno presto gli scienziati della Nasa, che scoprono che una stella di una galassia non lontana è diventata instabile e si è trasformata in una terribile supernova. Questo gigante stellare comincia ad emettere le sue micidiali microonde minacciando così la Terra e tutte le forme di vita che la abitano. Ma c'è ancora una speranza.

programme.title: Geo Disaster
programme.desc: Una famiglia di Los Angeles si trova separata durante la convergenza dei più grandi disastri della storia, un super vulcano, un mega-terremoto e un enorme tornado, e cercheranno di riunirsi a tutti i costi.

programme.title: Road Wars - Benvenuto All'inferno!
programme.desc: Road Wars - Benvenuto all'inferno!

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: 500 Mph Storm - Mega Tornado
programme.desc: Quando viene perso il controllo di un esperimento energetico, una gran quantità di uragani si abbatte sul Nord America. Un insegnante di scienze del liceo cercherà di mettere in salvo la sua famiglia prima dell'arrivo degli uragani, creando un "hypercane", un uragano potente abbastanza da annullare gli altri, ma in grado anche di cancellare gli Stati Uniti dalla faccia della Terra.

Ricordato come il Giorno del Giudizio dai sopravvissuti di quell'infernale olocausto, l'umanità riuscì a prevalere. Le creature ora son tornate. Una famiglia cerca di difendersi e di richiudere l'ingresso che permette ai mostri di raggiungere il pianeta.

programme.title: Android Cop
programme.desc: Il futuro delle forze dell'ordine. Nel 2045, un poliziotto e il suo partner androide entrano nella Zona, una sezione proibita della città abitata dalla popolazione colpita da una malattia sconosciuta. programme.desc: Nous suivons des voiliers et un photographe qui naviguent vers l'Antarctique, dans une région où le seul prédateur terrestre est le skua antarctique. programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Islande, sur la Piste du Renard Polaire
programme.desc: C'est une île posée sur un océan glacial, créée par les volcans, sculptée par les glaciers et les cascades. Au cœur de l'été, cette île accueille des millions d'oiseaux, qui malgré leur apparence légère sont incroyablement résistants. Au nord de cette île, on se lance dans une quête : rencontrer et filmer le seul mammifère originaire d'Islande.

programme.title: Nature Next Door
programme.sub-title: Nature Next Door - Costa Rica, le Royaume des Colibris
programme.desc: Le Costa Rica est une étroite bande de terre avec de chaque côté un océan. Des oiseaux multicolores, des reptiles un peu moins discret, mammifères plutôt curieux, partout se livre un fabuleux spectacle de la nature.

programme.title: RAZOR: Wooden Windmills
programme.desc: As we shift to green energy, it's important to ask—how green is the infrastructure itself? Take wind power: a typical onshore turbine needs around 480 tonnes of steel, and producing just one tonne of steel or cement releases up to two tonnes of CO2. In Sweden, engineers at Modvion are tackling this problem by building wind turbine towers out of wood. RAZOR meets the team behind Wind of Change, one of the tallest wooden towers in the world. Co-founder David Olivegren got the idea while building a boat, while CEO Otto Lundman explains how sustainably sourced wood is turned into strong, lightweight Laminated Veneer Lumber (LVL). CFO Maria-Lina Hedlund shares how the company aims to scale in a competitive green energy market.

programme.title: RAZOR: Predicting Volcanic Eruptions
programme.desc: Volcanoes rank among Earth's most powerful natural forces, shaping 80% of our planet's surface. Iceland, known as the land of fire and ice, owes its dynamic terrain to its location on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a tectonic boundary where the Eurasian and North American plates diverge. The frequent and varied eruptions here are a subject of great scientific interest. RAZOR's Reya El-Salahi meets a team of Volcanologists at the Nordic Volcanological Centre, at the University of Iceland, to find out how they are studying the most recent string of eruptions to uncover new details about this powerful geological process.

programme.title: Start small, dream big: Young entrepreneurs shape our future
programme.desc: Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions! Hear the incredible stories of the young entrepreneurs who are doing things differently. One connects beauty services with people in need, while the other turns waste into sustainable solutions, all while lifting up their communities. Don’t you miss this!

programme.title: Startup Secrets & Backstage Gossip! #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: Ever thought of turning human hair waste into sustainable products? How can young people take their first step in initiating their own business? At Suzhou Pingjiang Cultural Center, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions invites two young entrepreneurs to share their amazing stories. Click into the BehindTheScenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Discovering Guizhou: The Guitar Fanatic
programme.desc: In Zheng'an County, Guizhou province, a thriving guitar manufacturing industry has emerged, supplying major international brands and providing thousands of jobs. In this episode, we meet the guitar-makers, the musicians, and the dreamers who've transformed an entire region by turning strings into stories.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: How to build a digital twin of a city？
programme.desc: As cities expand and grow more intricate, a new kind of specialist is emerging behind the scenes: the urban digital twin engineer. In the coastal city of Qingdao, these experts are using real-time data and AI to build virtual replicas of the city—helping predict risks, improve infrastructure, and protect the public. CGTN's Liu Jiaxin takes us inside this fast-growing field.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: From trash to treasure
programme.desc: Jiao Jianwei is a senior engineer at the Longgang Energy Eco-Park inShenzhen. Every day, the facility processes 5,000 tonnes of waste, burning it togenerate electricity that powers millions of homes. The leftover ash is alsoturned into eco-bricks, used to pave city roads. From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions, and check out the stories of two KOLs from Ghana and Indonesia who use their creativity, empathy, and the shared desire to make people understand each other a little better.

programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: Meet China
programme.desc: CGTN launches a brand-new original program, Meet China, dedicated to showcasing China's vitality, strength, and potential. The program covers a wide range of topics, including the economy, innovation, culture, and exploration. Join us on a journey to experience the vibrant pulse of China's economy and immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Around China: Step Into Xishuangbanna’s Everyday Life at the Ganlanba Market
programme.desc: Beneath the Ganlanba Bridge in Xishuangbanna, a local market has become part of everyday life for residents. From street-side snacks to regional specialties like ganbai chicken and sticky rice cakes, the market is filled with the sights, sounds and flavors of daily life. Guided by local residents, CGTN reporter Elle Liao takes you inside the market to capture the most authentic rhythm of life in Yunnan.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

From landfills to incineration,China has transformed its waste industry with advanced technologies. Today,the country operates more than 1,000 waste-to-energy plants – nearly half theworld's total. With national goals like "carbon neutrality" and "zero-wastecities" taking shape, engineers like Jiao are turning trash into treasure.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who runs China's sea-roving protein factory?
programme.desc: Ever seen "fishermen" farming salmon on a vessel with a displacement bigger than some aircraft carriers? On China's Suhai-1 – the world's first deep-sea salmon and trout aquaculture vessel – these cold-water, high-latitude fish are now thriving far from their natural habitat.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: China's Drone Show Flight Planners
programme.desc: From the skies above Chongqing, thousands of drones light up the night in dazzling displays. Behind the spectacle, a new generation of artists and engineers is redefining entertainment – and showcasing China's growing technological and economic ambitions. In this story, we take a look at the work of a drone show flight planner.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Standing with sea giants
programme.desc: Along China's eastern shoreline, a new generation of energy workers is redefining what it meansto go to work. For offshore wind engineers, the office is the open sea. In this episode of ourspecial series Jobs 2.0, CGTN reporter Wang Tianyu takes us aboard to follow an engineer livingand working above the waves.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: KOLs and other ways to connect cultures
programme.desc: In what ways can KOLs better use their power in an age where a single video can reach millions? Tune in to #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions, and check out the stories of two KOLs from Ghana and Indonesia who use their creativity, empathy, and the shared desire to make people understand each other a little better.

programme.title: KOL traffic secrets: the power to drive change #GlobalSouthNextGen Behind the scenes
programme.desc: How do creators build traffic on social media? How can that influence spark real changes in society? In a cozy siheyuan, the iconic Beijing courtyard, another episode of #GlobalSouthNextGen: Voices and Visions brings together two KOLs who open up about their journeys, their strategies, and the impact from their content. Click into the Behind the Scenes video to find out more!

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: Highland industries, high-quality future
programme.desc: From smart ranching to vegetable greenhouses, from cold-chain logistics to cross-border trade… We take a look at Xizang's industrial transformation and see how the plateau is leaping into a new era of development.

programme.title: Meet China
programme.desc: CGTN launches a brand-new original program, Meet China, dedicated to showcasing China's vitality, strength, and potential. The program covers a wide range of topics, including the economy, innovation, culture, and exploration. Join us on a journey to experience the vibrant pulse of China's economy and immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Around China: Step Into Xishuangbanna’s Everyday Life at the Ganlanba Market
programme.desc: Beneath the Ganlanba Bridge in Xishuangbanna, a local market has become part of everyday life for residents. From street-side snacks to regional specialties like ganbai chicken and sticky rice cakes, the market is filled with the sights, sounds and flavors of daily life. Guided by local residents, CGTN reporter Elle Liao takes you inside the market to capture the most authentic rhythm of life in Yunnan.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Auto China: Driving future of mobility
programme.desc: Auto China 2026 opens on April 24, showcasing nearly 1,500 vehicles over 10 days – at a pivotal turning point for China's automotive industry. Amid commodity volatility and fractured supply chains, electrification is no longer a question of “if” but “how fast.” As the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) market and a major force of global EV sales, how is China shaping the pace and direction of this charge towards greener, smarter vehicles? Join us on BizTalk this week as we explore how China and Germany are moving in step toward the next phase of the future of mobility.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of milu deer
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.1
programme.desc: The Xiangjiang River runs 800 kilometers through the whole of Hunan Province. Hailed as the mother river of Hunan, it serves as a vital waterway connecting the Yangtze and Pearl River systems. Its source is located in Yongzhou, a land of abundant water resources, rich natural treasures and outstanding people. In this episode, we focus on three young women from Yongzhou: Pan Haiying, a dance teacher; Huang Cuilan, an inheritor of brocade weaving; and Hu Xin, a custodian of Nüshu culture. We document snippets of their daily lives and work, to reflect the profound cultural heritage along the Xiangjiang River and the value pursuits of the women living on its banks.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River
programme.desc: Ningxia: Echoes of the Yellow River is a documentary focusing on the World Heritage sites and cultural–ecological conservation in the Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region. Through the lens of Ningxia’s heritage stories, the film highlights China’s commitment to World Heritage preservation, ecological restoration, and cultural continuity — presenting to global audiences a land where history and modernity intertwine, and where desert and oasis coexist. By following the guardians of the Western Xia Imperial Tombs, desert restorers in the Tengger Desert, Great Wall rangers at Sanguankou, traditional sheepskin raft craftsmen, and managers of the Yellow River irrigation system in Qingtongxia, the program reveals Ningxia’s distinctive contributions to cultural heritage, natural ecology, and intangible traditions — and the enduring human spirit behind them.

programme.title: A Lifelong Journey of Xuan Paper
programme.desc: The host travels to Jingxian, Anhui—known as the hometown of Xuan paper—to experience the intricate process of making this traditional paper. Along the way, they uncover the secrets behind its thousand-year legacy and witness the craftsmanship of Xuan paper inheritors at every stage. Through vivid, personal stories, the episode reveals the hidden struggles and quiet perseverance that have kept this intangible cultural heritage alive across generations.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Inheritance matters more than fame
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Miao Embroidery: History in Stitches
programme.desc: According to legend, during a migration by the Miao ethnic group, a female chieftain wanted to keep a record of all the mountains and lakes she passed along the way. The means she chose of doing so was by stitching the images on her dress. By the time they reached a suitable place to settle, her clothing was covered with embroidered designs. This, it’s said, was the origin of Miao embroidery. As the story tells us, the designs in Miao embroidery are closely related to the natural world and daily life. The Miao people have a special fondness for nature. So, as well as depicting their daily farming and work activities, they copy birds, flowers, mountains, and grass onto their clothing. Over the years, the embroidery of the Miao people has become a written record of their life. The stitches are like characters which, when many of them are combined, become a record of their history, their collected wisdom, and the knowledge passed down from their ancestors.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Human Becoming
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: China Bound: Tianjin
programme.desc: Tianran He explores the vibrant port city of Tianjin. Strolling through its historic quarters, he discovers how old buildings are being preserved and revitalized, and savors the rich flavors of authentic Tianjin cuisine. To work off the calories, he joins energetic retirees for a morning workout in the park, then takes in the lively nightlife along the banks of the Haihe River. From folk handicrafts on Ancient Culture Street to the National Maritime Museum and an aircraft carrier theme park, Tianran discovers that Tianjin is a truly multifacted city.

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: Miao Silverware: A Shining Epic
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the fascinating world of the silver-working art of the Miao ethnic group. Join us, and hear the stories and see the works of four remarkable individuals. From a national-level inheritor who is preserving the traditional craft, to an artist infusing personal flair into his designs; from a female silversmith imbuing her work with feminine warmth, to a young artisan inspiring a new generation, we investigate the rich heritage, cultural significance, and evolving potential of Miao silverware.

programme.title: Xinjiang On the Road
programme.desc: Join an international group on an ice-snow adventure across northern Xinjiang, exploring stunning winter scenery, rich ethnic culture and warm hospitality from Urumqi to Altay.

programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Human Becoming
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Tiempo sin aire
programme.desc: Maria, una enfermera cuya hija fue asesinada por tres paramilitares, viaja desde Colombia a España con su hijo menor para vengarse.

programme.title: El 24
programme.desc: Un famoso matón a sueldo, se da a la tarea de matar a Manuel, un hombre que se metió con la amante de un importante jefe.

programme.title: Puerta de Hierro, El Exilio de Perón
programme.desc: La casa del presidente exiliado, lejos de Buenos Aires, se vuelve centro de resistencia popular.

programme.title: Flor de Azúcar
programme.desc: Un joven campesino se ve obligado a huir después de matar involuntariamente a un guardia abusivo. Después de pasar un año entero escondido en una remota isla de pesca, decide regresar a su campo y reunirse con su esposa e hijas.

programme.title: La Noche mas fria
programme.desc: Carlos es un amable hombre sin hogar que después de perder a su familia trágicamente, vive en una plaza de la ciudad y ahora busca incansablemente a su hijo Álvaro.

programme.title: Niños Asesinos
programme.desc: Niños asesinos presenta 4 expedientes, 4 historias reales de niños involucrados en homicidios. Cuatro vidas que convergen en el punto mas culminante para asesinar.

programme.title: Las dos vidas de Andrés Rabadán
programme.desc: Está basada en hechos reales y explora la vida de Andrés Rabadán, conocido en la prensa como "el loco de la ballesta".

programme.title: Plan Sexenal
programme.desc: Esta es una historia sobre las fantasías de una mujer acerca del amor, la violencia y la energía que surge al contemplar la posibilidad de ser alguien más en un contexto adverso.

programme.desc: Carlos es un amable hombre sin hogar que después de perder a su familia trágicamente, vive en una plaza de la ciudad y ahora busca incansablemente a su hijo Álvaro.
